main_measure.name: mean unusual 72-bar return of the bets (return minus coin's normal drift), pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting check passes); reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 30 independent cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual return of larger-forecast half minus smaller-forecast half > 0

decided_by: Mean unusual 72-bar return above 0 with t >= 2, but the larger-forecast half does not beat the smaller half.
reading: Bets are long forecast rises of at least 2 points from the lowest level since the last bet (reset to 0 when flat), the first per 72-bar grid cell counted from each window's first row, with cases lacking 72 bars ahead in the window dropped; the median split puts forecasts above the median in the larger half and those at or below it in the smaller half; a missed 30-case minimum is reported as not observable.
